title: Chart and history
summary: A chart of the balance, and a history kept on the phone.
done: You saw a chart and variables kept on the phone.

hello.text: In level 4, a chart, and the piggy bank remembers everything, even after closing it.

stored.text: The **moves** and **goal** variables are now *stored*: the phone keeps them. When it opens, we show everything again.

chart.text: In the loop, each movement adds a point to the **chart**: the total at that moment.

label.text: The round [if … then … else …] block gives a value: “+” for money in, nothing for spending (which already has its “-”).

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Add money: a point is added for each movement.
watch.hint: Type a number in the preview, then tap “+ Add”.

bars.text: Make a bar chart instead of a line.
bars.hint: Select the chart in Design: its type.

count.text: Also show the number of movements.
